disclaimer.medical: This app does not provide medical advice.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: We will send a code by SMS to confirm your number.

errors.invalidPhone: That phone number is not valid. Use international format, for example +919876543210.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.invalidCode: That code is not correct. Check the message and try again.
errors.incompleteCode: Enter all 6 digits of the code.
errors.sessionExpired: That code can no longer be used. Send a new code and try again.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

today.emptyDescription: Parents you add will appear here with today's doses.

medicines.title: Medicines
medicines.emptyDescription: Medicines you add for a parent will be listed here.
medicines.deactivateWarning: Deactivating stops future calls for this medicine. Its history is kept.
medicines.readOnly: Only the family owner or an editor can change medicines.

errors.noTimes: Add at least one dose time.
errors.failed: Could not save the medicine. Please try again.

family.title: Family
family.emptyDescription: Parents you add will appear here with their consent status.
family.consentPending: Calls start after consent is granted

addParent.title: Add a parent
addParent.subtitle: The app will call this parent at medicine times.

errors.failed: Could not add the parent. Please try again.

invite.title: Invite family
invite.subtitle: Invite a sibling to help care for {{name}}.
invite.roleEditorDescription: Can add medicines and record doses.

errors.notOwner: Only the family owner can create invite codes.
errors.failed: Could not create the invite code. Please try again.

redeem.title: Enter invite code

errors.invalidFormat: That code is not valid. It is 8 letters and numbers.
errors.unknown: This invite code is not valid.
